name: scipy_milp_integer

planned.name: scipy_milp_integer
steps: Formulate as MILP: min 4X + 3Y subject to X + Y <= 1000, X >= 2Y + 300, X,Y integers >= 0
Use scipy.optimize.milp with bounds=(0, inf), constraints=linear inequalities, integrality=1
Extract optimal X, Y and compute objective = 4*X + 3*Y
Write result to result.json with status/objective_value/variables

key_idea: Two-variable bounded ILP; scipy.optimize.milp handles mixed-integer directly via integrality constraint; efficient for small variable count

name: enumeration_with_constraints

planned.name: enumeration_with_constraints
steps: Enumerate Y from 0 to 233, compute minimal feasible X for each Y
For each feasible (X,Y), compute cost = 4X + 3Y and pick minimum
Because cost coefficients 4>3, minimizing X minimizes cost; exploit constraint tight bounds to prune

key_idea: Direct enumeration with tight bounds derived from constraints; leverages monotonicity to prune efficiently
